language.label: App language
language.desc: Checks work in all three languages whatever you pick

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.desc: Dark is easier on the eyes at night

simple.label: Simple results
simple.desc: Show a result as the verdict and the one reason that matters most

history.label: Keep my check history
history.desc: On by default. Saved only on this device, never on our servers.

share.label: Share anonymous scam samples
share.desc: Helps Radar warn others. We keep a fingerprint of a scam, the sender it claims and its links, never the message itself.

extension.label: Browser extension
extension.desc: Warns you before you open a known scam link. Turn it on or off in the extension itself.

alerts.label: Scam alerts
alerts.desc: A notification when a scam campaign starts spreading on Radar. Checked while FraudLens is open, and in the background where your browser allows it.

practice.label: Daily practice reminder
practice.desc: One evening nudge if today's Learn practice isn't done. Sent while FraudLens is open, and in the background where your browser allows it.

notif.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.

delete.confirm: Delete every check saved on this device? This can't be undone.

notifications.alertBody: Seen in {count} checks on FraudLens. Open Radar to see what it looks like.
notifications.practiceBody: Today's Learn messages are waiting. Keep your streak going.
